use_case_summary: Support platform for a 24/7 contact center provider. Primary flows: agent-assist (real-time suggestions + canned responses), ticket summarization (end-of-shift batch), and tool-calling (automatic CRM update, internal escalation via webhook). High importance on reliability during incident bursts (severe weather, product incidents) and seasonal peaks. Want automatic fallback routing to cheaper model for non-actionable suggestions, and guaranteed throughput during timed promotions.
requirements_details: SLOs: conversational agent turn latency <= 300ms median, <= 700ms p95 in normal load; during peak acceptable up to 1s p95 but must not exceed 1.5s for critical tool-calls.
Throughput target: baseline 5k concurrent sessions, burst to 18k concurrent (x3.6) for up to 48 hours.
Cost sensitivity: want optimize recommendations to reduce per-token spend during long-run peaks; target blended token cost reduction >= 25% vs current.
Routing: sticky agent-session routing, region affinity (NA primary, EU fallback), automatic downgrade to compatible model variants when Dedicated capacity saturated.
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency heatmaps, and alerting for queue-depth thresholds.
Operational controls: canary rollouts, automatic fallback policies, and immediate circuit-breaker when queue depth > configured threshold.
Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance, audit logs with 12-month retention, KMS integration for key management, and proof of EU data residency for EU customers.
notes: AE notes: strong fit for Dedicated + Optimize. Want committed burst SLA — procurement will push for monthly reserve with burst pool. Need pricing scenarios for 3 tiers of reserved burst capacity.
